title: Agent Audit Tracker: standards and drafts for audit evidence of AI agent actions
description:
A public, status-only catalogue of the standards, specifications and Internet-Drafts that define audit evidence for AI agent actions (OpenTelemetry GenAI conventions, IETF agent identity and audit-record drafts, OAuth RFCs, SCITT, MCP, A2A, OWASP agentic lists, NIST SP 800-53, ISO/IEC 27001 A.8.15, PCI DSS Requirement 10, EU AI Act Article 12). A weekly job records each document's revision, status, citations, related drafts and provenance (source, revision, SHA-256, check time). It does not assess documents or monitor agents.

Live site: https://anustsn.github.io/agent-audit-tracker/

Code is MIT-licensed. Data files are CC BY 4.0, except data/requirements.json, which is CC BY-SA 4.0 (derived from OWASP); see LICENSE-DATA.md.
